name: Fujishima Nanako
source:
Her parents died when she was young and she was raised by some relatives.
But when it was time to enter high school she decided to start living alone in the old house she used to live in.
A bright and optimistic girl, the most straightforward member of her group of childhood friends the 'Shinobazu Seven'.
